basis: snapshot writer count/free_list/entities; ordinary component reach tuple comma-fold; continuous get restores owner then copies Link value without calling update

types.integer: JSON integer, never boolean; nonnegative where count or macro; no floating encodings
types.missing_observation: JSON null, not a null entity handle

live_handle.scope: Only identities reported live in this frozen ordinary create/no-hint/no-destruction condition; not a fixed allocation or version-zero oracle

declaration.compiler_macros: gcc and clang each null or exactly three nonnegative integers; no specific compiler version prescribed

invariants: Every live R,H,S,B,L must have index != 1048575 and version != 4095, in addition to exact full/index/version decomposition; full != 4294967295 alone is insufficient
R,H,S are non-null; R != H; do not require R or H to differ from S across registries
R,H,S and source_target/archive_target remain identical across stages
source_target == archive_target == R == links token target
source_box_valid == source_holder_valid == seed_valid == true at every complete stage
entity_written == 4 and link_written == 3 at every stage
after entity load: B,L non-null and target-valid, B != L, B != S, L != S
B != R must pass before attempting Link consumption; do not add seeds or modify inputs if it fails
component stage preserves B,L from entity stage
loaded_target == input_target == R and loaded_target != B
loaded_target_equals_seed is the exact full-handle comparison R == S
loaded_target_in_local_valid is descriptive, not fixed true or false; for this closed three-live-entity target it must be consistent with R belonging to {S,B,L}
no component access before mapped holder validity and Link presence checks
repeat_policy: At most two fresh copies after separate code/execution approval; identical typed records including actual entity token order; never sort records to conceal differences
failure_policy: Emit actual facts then check stage; safety preconditions before get; any truncated or inconsistent run is not success; stop without repair or retry
environment_gate: New owned build/native phase roots; five HOME/XDG/TMPDIR directories prepared and validated immediately before each Popen; partial preparation and process cleanup separate; not a sandbox
clarification: v2: live identity guards distinguish EnTT null index semantics and reserved tombstone version from the concrete unknown-map null representation; no new native condition
